title: iPhone Model Check: Case & Charger Finder
lead: Enter your model number to see your exact iPhone model, which case size to buy, and which charger connector you need.
privacy: Your input is checked on this device only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
howTitle: How to find your model number
how1: On your iPhone, open the Settings app and tap General.
how3: To the right of Model Number you'll see the part number (e.g. MTxxxLL/A).
how4: Tap the part number. It changes to the model number that starts with A (e.g. A2849). Enter that number.
howAlt: If the screen doesn't work: on iPhone 8 or later with a SIM tray, remove the tray and look inside the slot (display side). Without a SIM tray, look inside the USB-C or Lightning connector (display side) in bright light.
howSrc: Source: Apple, "Find the model number of your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch"
errInvalid: That doesn't look right. A model number is "A" followed by 4 digits (e.g. A2849).
errUnknown: {a} is not in this tool's data (numbers confirmed on Apple's official pages). It may be a non-iPhone number or a typo.
errLegacy: {a} is the model number of {name} (confirmed on Apple's page). This tool covers iPhone 8 and later, so no case/charger result is shown.
partInfo: Apple does not publish a table that maps part number {p} to a model, so this tool does not guess.
partHow: In Settings > General > About, tap this part number once and it changes to the model number starting with "A". Enter that number under "Model number".
caseNgShort: ({list}: different size or camera position, so not compatible)
caseSameHead: Same dimensions, camera count and buttons in Apple's specs
caseSameNote: A case works if its compatibility list names both {list} and your model. Otherwise choose a case for {name}.
reason_camera: different rear camera count or layout
foldNote: It's a foldable, so choose a case made for iPhone Duo.
foldSize: Open {o} mm / closed {c} mm (H × W × D, Apple specs)
chgAdapter: Charger: USB-C (USB PD) {w}W or higher recommended (per Apple)
chgAdapterAvs: Charger: USB-C (USB PD with Adjustable Voltage Supply) {w}W or higher recommended (per Apple)
chgCable_usbc-usbc: Cable: USB-C to USB-C (the iPhone has a USB-C port)
chgCable_usbc-lightning: Cable: USB-C to Lightning (the iPhone has a Lightning port)
chgXNote: The spec page gives no wattage. Wattage is from Apple's "Fast charge your iPhone" (Apple 18W or greater USB-C adapter, or a comparable third-party USB-C adapter that supports USB-PD).
wlMagsafeAdapter: Adapter for MagSafe fast charging: {w}W or higher
wlNoMagsafe: MagSafe: not listed in tech specs
iosNo: {v}: not supported (Apple's lists go up to {last})
